TOST.difference: MAE_trainable_seed minus deterministic ECM2RC MAE, using same condition and mode
TOST.lower: Exact one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on d+1 with alternative greater (H0 location<=-1)
TOST.upper: Exact one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on d-1 with alternative less (H0 location>=+1)
TOST.implementation: Round shifted differences to10 decimals; remove zeros, average tied absolute ranks, exhaust all2^n sign permutations. Allzero =>p1. Record both p-values and n_nonzero.
TOST.multiplicity: Holm over20conditions separately for each model, mode and one-sided direction. Equivalence iff BOTH adjusted p<0.05. No NLS seed replication.
TOST.interpretation: TOST concerns seed-distribution location under signed-rank symmetry assumptions, not equivalence across independent cells. Neither nonsignificance nor failed equivalence demonstrates benefit.

LSTM.effect: Median paired seed MAE difference LSTM minus deterministic ECM2RC
LSTM.bootstrap: 20000 resamples of10 seed differences with replacement, percentile2.5/97.5CI, RNG20261101; no p-value or equivalence test
